articles.title: HP Police Constable Recruitment 2026: HPPSC extends application deadline for 734 vacancies to August 21
articles.summary: HP Police Constable Recruitment 2026: The Himachal Pradesh Public Service Commission has extended the last date to apply for HP Police Constable Recruitment 2026. Eligible candidates can now submit Online Recruitment Applications for 734 constable vacancies until August 21, 2026.

articles.title: NMMSS Scholarship 2026-27 applications close on August 31; check eligibility, benefits and application process
